stories.title: US school bus drivers decline amid low pay and poor work conditions
summary: Total number of drivers dropped 5% over the last year and fell 15% compared with 2019 levels, new report findsThe number of school bus drivers in the US has dropped 5% over the last year as drivers continue to experience low pay, poor working conditions and school budget shortfalls, according to a new report.The total number of school bus drivers is down 15%, or nearly 34,000 drivers, compared with 2019 levels, according to an new analysis from the Economic Policy Institute.

stories.title: EU to impose cap on Chinese hybrid EV imports next month
summary: Temporary quotas on vehicles entering the bloc will also apply to cars from the UK, Japan and TurkeyThe EU will next month impose its threatened caps on the number of Chinese hybrid cars that can be imported into the bloc, the European Commission has announced.The quotas will also apply to hybrids from Japan, Turkey, South Korea and the UK, but the principal purpose is to limit imports from China after an agreement with Beijing in October that has led to a rise in exports to the bloc.
